goal: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE: use the select tool to select 'MAIN-001 - Main Office' in the Branch dropdown, type operator ID 'teller1', type password 'password', click Sign On. Click 'Member Inquiry', type member number '100234' into the search value field, click Search, click 'Select'. On the member record page, click 'Funds Transfer'. Once you reach the Funds Transfer form, extract the page's heading text (the value with role heading) as an output named transfer_heading, then immediately call done referencing that output. Do not interact with the From Share, To Share, Amount, or Memo fields at all.
final_summary: Signed on to MERIDIAN CORE with branch MAIN-001, operator teller1, navigated to Member Inquiry, searched for member 100234, selected the member record, and navigated to Funds Transfer form. Extracted the page heading 'FUNDS TRANSFER' without interacting with the From Share, To Share, Amount, or Memo fields.
